description: Ministry of Lands - Regulations made to amend the Land Acquisition (Payment of Compensation) Regulations 2013 Published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1864/54 of 30.05.2014
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Lands under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically amending the Land Acquisition (Payment of Compensation) Regulations 2013. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters - amendments to existing regulations and statutory instruments - rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, land transactions, or other specialized categories.
